title: 第十七章 统统打死毫不客气第十八章 震惊各方消息哗然
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 林玄心中冰冷，一路远走。
他现在只想调查出吉庆胡同大火的真相。
其他任何事情都无法阻拦他。
夜晚的大街，处处都是朦胧的路灯。
还有一辆辆黄包车在四处穿行。
又有各种卖小吃的。
一些娱乐场所更是灯红酒绿，歌舞不停。
远处的工厂也是昼夜不停的运转着，冒出滚滚蒸汽，声音轰鸣。
机械、蒸汽、武学、鬼怪...
各类东西混在一起。
荒诞而又离奇。
在他一路向着宾馆方向走去的时候。
突然。
一侧的巷子中再次传来一道诡异的脚步声，这声音好似踩踏在他人的心脏上一样，与人的心跳莫名其妙的共鸣在一起。
好像每一步落下，自己的心脏都会跟着跳动一下。
这脚步声越来越密，越来越沉。
就如同一道重鼓在不断响起。
林玄脚步一顿，面无表情，转头向着一侧巷子看去。
他体内劲力流淌，那种心跳紊乱的错觉瞬间消失不见。
“可是林老将军？”
平静声音从巷子传来。
一条身穿白色短褂，白色裤子的青年，满脸平静与自信，背负双手，从巷子之内一步步走来。
在他的胸口位置，以玄青色丝绸绣着四个大字。
天下武会。
“你是？”
林玄皱起眉头。
这又是什么势力？
“老先生，莫非不认识字？”
突然，旁边也传来轻笑之声。
又是一位青年男子迈步走了过来，脸色自信，穿着白色短褂，胸口绣着一样的字迹。
在这青年男子走出后。
其他方向，又紧跟着走来了三位青年男子。
各个带着自信飞扬的笑容。
此外，远处还有混乱的脚步声传来。
竟还有记者出现，手中扛着老式摄像机，出现在这里。
林玄面色一沉，有种心烦意燥之感。
“你们要做什么？”
刚刚杀了两人，心中郁火尚未平息。
竟又有人不知死活！
“老先生，今日我们没有别的意思。”
那最先出现的白衣青年，神色平静，双目精湛，看向林玄，笑道：“我们只是想借先生头颅一用，以唤醒国人！”
content_en:
Lin Xuan's heart was cold and he walked away.
Now he just wants to investigate the truth about the Jiqing Hutong fire.
Nothing else could stop him.
The streets at night are full of dim street lights.
There are also rickshaws driving around.
There are also various snack vendors.
Some entertainment venues are even more festive, with non-stop singing and dancing.
The factory in the distance is also running day and night, with billowing steam and roaring sounds.
Machinery, steam, martial arts, ghosts...
All kinds of things mixed together.
Absurd and bizarre.
As he walked all the way towards the hotel.
Sudden.
A strange sound of footsteps came from the alley on one side again. This sound seemed to be stepping on someone else's heart, inexplicably resonating with the human heartbeat.
It seems that with every step, my heart will beat.
The footsteps became thicker and thicker.
It was like a heavy drum that kept sounding.
Lin Xuan paused, expressionless, and turned to look towards the alley.
Power flowed through his body, and the illusion of erratic heartbeat disappeared instantly.
"But General Lin?"
A calm voice came from the alley.
A young man wearing a white short coat and white pants, with a calm and confident face, walked step by step from the alley with his hands behind his back.
On his chest, four large characters were embroidered on dark blue silk.
World martial arts meeting.
"You are?"
Lin Xuan frowned.
What kind of force is this?
"Old sir, is it possible that you don't know how to read?"
Suddenly, a chuckle came from the side.
Another young man walked over with a confident face, wearing a white short coat with the same calligraphy embroidered on his chest.
After the young man walked out.
In other directions, three young men followed closely.
Each with a confident smile.
In addition, there were chaotic footsteps in the distance.
There were actually reporters appearing here, carrying old-fashioned cameras in their hands.
Lin Xuan's face darkened, feeling upset.
"What are you going to do?"
Having just killed two people, the anger in his heart has not yet subsided.
There are people who don’t know whether to live or die!
"Old sir, we have nothing else to do today."
The young man in white clothes who appeared first had a calm expression and exquisite eyes. He looked at Lin Xuan and said with a smile: "We just want to borrow Mr.'s head to awaken the people of the country!"
title_en: Chapter 17: Beat them all to death without mercy Chapter 18: The news shocked all parties and caused an uproar
